connector.name: Orcaslicer MCP
connector.registryDescription: Drive a running OrcaSlicer with AI: load models, tune settings, slice, and analyze results
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package orcaslicer-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the maxellis account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ORCA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Remote API token from the OrcaSlicer MCP build (Preferences -> Remote API)

env.name: ORCA_API_URL
env.description: OrcaSlicer Remote API address; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:13130
